notes: The second question gaps both הֲ and לֹא; the repeated English have and not are read as distributed realizations of the written morphemes (rule 25) rather than as added units. The competing readings would mark t009 and t011 added, or give t009 to the second verb as its perfect auxiliary; the unit notes name them.
s010: in that is one rendering of the waw whose clause it opens (rule 55), headed on that since no coordinator is written.
